messages.author: d801fdf2fefdd38e
messages.subject: occu tilda definition
parts:
Hi unmarked users,
I'm having trouble understanding how exactly to set up my model using the occu() function. What exactly do the tildas separate? From playing around, it seems like between the tildas is detection probability and after the tildas is occupancy. Is this correct? For example, if I am looking at the effect of area on detection and vegetation on occupancy, I would set up the model like this:
occu(~Area ~ Vegetation , data=umf). 
Am I correct here, or am I misinterpreting? Also, what if I want to look at the effect of area on both detection probability and on occupancy, is this possible? Example:
occu(~Area ~ Area, data=umf)
Thank you for any help you can provide,
Mikey

messages.author: 4a15de51da4445ae
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] occu tilda definition
parts:
hi Mikey,
 You are correct -- the first formula is detection, the 2nd one is occupancy.
 You may model Area as a covariate on both.
regards
andy
